notes: 達悟語（ciriciring no Tao）詞卡。原型階段以公開文獻常見羅馬拼音為準，完整語句與構詞需與族語協作者校訂。拼寫可見文獻變體。 族語拼寫依《原住民族語言書寫系統》雅美（達悟）語：喉塞音字母一律寫作 ’（U+2019），ng／n-g 以連字號區分，非末音節重音標 í á é ó。

entries.detail: 達悟族人對蘭嶼的自稱地名，意為「人之島」。遊戲世界以此為正式名。
entries.detailEn: The Tao people's own name for Lanyu, meaning "Island of People". The game uses it as the island's official name.

entries.detail: 飛魚季的開端（約陽曆 2–3 月）。各船組在灘頭舉行儀式，召喚飛魚到來。文獻亦作 mivanwa。
entries.detailEn: The start of the flying fish season (about Feb–Mar). Each boat crew holds a ceremony on the beach to call the flying fish. Also written mivanwa.

entries.detail: 約陽曆 2–6 月，隨黑潮而來的飛魚汛期。是歲時與漁獵生活的核心季節，而不只是單一「祭典」。
entries.detailEn: About Feb–Jun, when flying fish arrive with the Kuroshio current. It's the heart of the yearly cycle of fishing life, not just one "festival".

entries.detail: 約中秋前後，飛魚相關祭儀的終章。此後不再食用飛魚乾，表達對飛魚的尊重。
entries.detailEn: Around the Mid-Autumn Festival, the last flying fish ceremony. After it, dried flying fish are no longer eaten, out of respect for the fish.

entries.detail: 達悟族對飛魚的稱呼。飛魚被視為神聖的儀式性魚類，捕撈與食用都有嚴謹規範。
entries.detailEn: The Tao word for flying fish. Flying fish are a sacred ceremonial fish, with strict rules for catching and eating them.

entries.detail: 家庭或個人使用的拼板舟，約二十一塊板拼合，單體雙尖、無舷外浮木。請勿擅自觸碰。
entries.detailEn: A plank boat for a family or one person, made of about 21 planks, double-pointed with no outrigger. Please don't touch one without asking.

entries.detail: 漁團共同使用的大船，通常 6–10 人、三至五對槳。飛魚季夜間火把招魚多由大船漁團進行。
entries.detailEn: A big boat shared by a fishing crew, usually 6–10 people with three to five pairs of paddles. Night torch fishing in flying fish season is mostly done by big-boat crews.

entries.detail: 蘭嶼梯田栽培的水芋，是日常主食與祭儀共享中極重要的作物，常與飛魚乾搭配。
entries.detailEn: Taro grown in Lanyu's terraced water fields. A key daily staple and shared in ceremonies, often eaten with dried flying fish.

entries.detail: 部分文化資料以此指芋頭田。
entries.detailEn: Some cultural sources use this word for the taro field.
entries.review: 詞義與拼寫須與族語協作者確認後鎖定（原註：Phase C）。

entries.detail: 部落中休息、作工與聚會的高架涼亭。上涼亭請脫鞋。
entries.detailEn: A raised pavilion in the village for resting, working and meeting. Take your shoes off before climbing up.

entries.detail: 主島南方的小島，與紅頭海域的漁獵範圍相關。
entries.detailEn: The small island south of the main island, tied to the fishing grounds of the Imorod waters.

entries.detail: 達悟族的語言。本遊戲以臺灣傳統漢字＋羅馬拼音呈現，不用簡體中文。
entries.detailEn: The language of the Tao people. This game shows it with Traditional Chinese and romanized spelling.

entries.tao: ’ · ng / n-g · í á é ó
entries.zh: 族語書寫筆記（原住民族語言書寫系統）
entries.detail: 依教育部／原民會《原住民族語言書寫系統》雅美（達悟）語：「’」是喉塞音字母（不是重音符號），遊戲一律用彎引號 ’（U+2019），不用直撇號 '。ng 連寫是一個鼻音，如 mangay「去」；n 與 g 分開念時加連字號，如 man-gamo「開人玩笑」。重音多在最後一個音節，不在最後時教材會標 í、á、é、ó。常用字：vahay 家、among 魚、ili 部落、tao 人。（參考：《雅美（達悟）語語法概論》第二章，何德華、董瑪女，原民會 2018；書寫系統 113 年修正對照表）
entries.detailEn: Following the official writing system for Yami (Tao): "’" is a letter for the glottal stop, not an accent mark. The game always uses the curly ’ (U+2019), never the straight '. ng written together is one nasal sound, as in mangay "go"; when n and g are said apart, add a hyphen, as in man-gamo "tease someone". Stress is usually on the last syllable; when it isn't, textbooks mark í, á, é, ó. Common words: vahay house, among fish, ili village, tao person. (Source: An Introduction to Yami (Tao) Grammar, ch. 2, by D. Victoria Rau and Maa-Neu Dong, Council of Indigenous Peoples, 2018; 2024 revised writing system table)

entries.detail: 打招呼的話。見到長輩先說一聲 akokey。
entries.detailEn: A greeting. When you meet an elder, say akokey first.
entries.source: 族語 E 樂園「生活常用語」雅美語（暫定）
entries.sourceEn: ePark Indigenous language site, "Everyday phrases", Yami (provisional)

entries.detail: 長輩那句「ikongo yamyan do wawa?」裡的 wawa，就是海。
entries.detailEn: In the elder's line "ikongo yamyan do wawa?", wawa means the sea.
entries.source: 族語 E 樂園第 5 階第 9 課（暫定）
entries.sourceEn: ePark Indigenous language site, level 5, lesson 9 (provisional)

entries.detail: 螃蟹的通稱。陸蟹的專名還要請族人告訴我們。
entries.detailEn: The general word for crab. We still need the Tao community to tell us the word for land crabs.
entries.source: 族語 E 樂園第 5 階第 9 課（暫定）
entries.sourceEn: ePark Indigenous language site, level 5, lesson 9 (provisional)

entries.detail: 家屋旁養的豬。
entries.detailEn: Pigs kept beside the family house.
entries.source: 何德華、董瑪女《達悟語：語料、參考語法、及詞彙》（暫定）
entries.sourceEn: Rau & Dong, Yami Texts with Reference Grammar and Dictionary (provisional)

entries.detail: 島的西岸，開元港旁的部落。
entries.detailEn: The village on the west coast, next to Kaiyuan Harbour.

entries.detail: 島的北岸的部落。
entries.detailEn: The village on the north coast.

entries.detail: 島的東岸，面向東清灣的部落。
entries.detailEn: The village on the east coast, facing Dongqing Bay.

entries.detail: 島的東南岸的部落，傳統家屋保留得很完整。
entries.detailEn: The village on the southeast coast, where traditional houses are best kept.

entries.detail: 島的西南岸的部落，衛生所在這一帶。
entries.detailEn: The village on the southwest coast, near the health station.

entries.detail: 島的西岸，機場旁的部落。
entries.detailEn: The village on the west coast, next to the airport.

entries.detail: 山上和路邊常見的羊。每家的羊，耳朵上有自己家的記號。
entries.detailEn: Goats are a common sight on the hills and by the road. Each family's goats have the family's own mark on their ears.
entries.review: 待族人確認：寫法與是否只指山羊
